events.title: Queensland Garden Expo
events.description: Australia's premier gardening event featuring over 360 exhibitors, 10 live stages with free lectures and demonstrations, workshops, garden displays, and a floral design competition. Attracts gardeners, experts, and plant lovers.

events.title: Australian Wearable Art Festival – Gala
events.location: Novotel Twin Waters Resort, Twin Waters
events.description: A local celebration where fashion meets art, featuring bold new themes, sublime garments, and dazzling creations on a 27-metre runway. Includes hands-on workshops, a captivating gallery exhibition, and opportunities to meet the artists.

events.title: Convergence 5 – TRIBONE & AKUDRA (Psytrance / Electronic)
events.location: Banana Bender Pub / The Shed, Palmview
events.description: Experience the hypnotic fusion of TRIBONE and AKUDRA as they bring their signature blend of progressive psytrance, deep grooves, and cutting-edge electronic soundscapes to this vibrant event.

events.title: Fonoti – Live Beer Garden Session
events.description: Ease into your Sunday with the smooth sounds of Fonoti in the relaxed beer garden, perfect for cruisy catch-ups and enjoying live music.

events.title: Max Jackson – "Dangerous In Denim" Tour
events.description: Catch Max Jackson's 'Dangerous In Denim Tour' at Kings Beach Tavern, one of the Sunshine Coast's major live music destinations known for its regular entertainment acts.

events.title: NightQuarter – Friday Night Markets & Live Music
events.description: Experience an electric atmosphere of global street food, live music on multiple stages, carnival fun, immersive performances, and market shopping in a family-friendly setting.

events.title: NightQuarter – Saturday Night Markets & Live Music
events.description: Enjoy a vibrant weekend evening with multiple stages of live entertainment, themed bars, street food, amusement rides, and market shopping, catering to all ages.

events.title: Open Mic Night – Solbar Maroochydore
events.description: The Sunshine Coast's longest-running open mic night offers a relaxed, intimate atmosphere for acoustic acts to perform or for guests to simply enjoy live local music.

events.title: Solbar – Weekend Gigs
events.description: Solbar, the Sunshine Coast's iconic music venue, hosts live performances from various artists over the weekend in its Band Room and street-front lounge bar. Check their gig guide for specific acts.

events.title: Mary River Festival
events.description: A vibrant community celebration highlighting the environmental, cultural, and social importance of the Mary River region in the Sunshine Coast hinterland.

events.title: Banana Bender Pub – Hump Day Poker Night
events.description: A weekly poker night powered by APL, offering free entry and a $20 pizza special, perfect for a casual social gathering to test your strategy.

events.title: Banana Bender Pub – Thursday Trivia / Brain & Burger Night
events.description: Gather your friends for a weekly trivia night with unique twists, free to play and featuring a $20 burger & chips special, ideal for an intellectually engaging social evening.
